observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: An outdoor street between buildings in a village or town, decorated with red banners and flags during daylight.
observation.dancers: A group of young adults and teenagers, primarily women in matching military-style uniforms, performing together.
observation.formation_and_space: Organized rows and columns moving rhythmically in unison down the street, with a flag-bearer waving a large red flag in the center.
observation.posture: Upright, rigid posture with straight torso and knees lifting high in a marching style.
observation.footwork: Marching step with high knee lifts on the beat, moving forward and in place.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms swing and punch forward or raise diagonally upward, holding small red books or flags.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains stiff and upright with no isolated hip movements.
observation.partnering: None, performed in unison group formation.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Standing level throughout with high knee marching; no jumps or floor work, occasional turning in formation.
observation.costume_and_props: Matching green military-style jackets, dark trousers, caps, and red armbands, holding small red books and large red flags.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and precise weight transfer cannot be determined due to distant camera angles.
